parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button located on the toaster body, used to control functions such as canceling or adjusting settings.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to stop the toasting process or select specific modes.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Slider
parts.Basic_description: A plastic lever or slider on the side of the toaster used to lower the bread into the heating chamber.
parts.Functional_description: It engages the internal heating mechanism and timer when pushed down.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward and locks in place during operation, then springs back up when toasting is complete.

parts.name: Bread (Other)
parts.Basic_description: A slice of bread placed inside the toaster slots, made of organic material.
parts.Functional_description: It is the item being toasted; it absorbs heat and undergoes browning reactions.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during toasting and pops up when the process is complete.

parts.name: Cable (Other)
parts.Basic_description: An electrical cable that connects the toaster to a power source, consisting of copper wires and PVC insulation.
parts.Functional_description: It supplies electrical power to the toaster’s heating elements and control circuits.
parts.Movement_description: It is flexible and can bend freely but remains connected to the toaster body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the toaster, made of stainless steel, housing all internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support, heat resistance, and protection for internal electrical and mechanical parts.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed frame for all other components.
